description:
Please automate a simple curation step for a binary artifact repository located at /home/user/artifact_repo. The repository contains multiple subdirectories, each named for a project (e.g., project_alpha, project_beta), and each of those contains binary files with extensions .bin and .exe. I would like you to write a shell script at /home/user/scripts/curate_artifacts.sh that will do the following: 1. Scan every project directory inside /home/user/artifact_repo. 2. For each project directory, list the full paths of all .bin and .exe files found there. 3. Write a log file at /home/user/curation_logs/artifact_curation.log with the following format: - The log file must list each project directory, one at a time, starting with a header line: Project: <project_dir_name> - Under each header, print each discovered file’s full path, one per line. - If a project directory contains no .bin or .exe files, write No artifacts found. below its header. - There should be a blank line between listings for each project directory. Example snippet of the log file for two projects: 
Project: project_alpha
/home/user/artifact_repo/project_alpha/core.bin
/home/user/artifact_repo/project_alpha/runner.exe

Project: project_beta
No artifacts found.
Make sure the script is executable, and all output directories exist and are writable. This will help us automate the artifact curation process and verify repository contents easily.

After the agent completes the task, the following files should exist: - /home/user/scripts/curate_artifacts.sh: a shell script, executable by the user, that scans the artifact repository as described. - /home/user/curation_logs/artifact_curation.log: the log file with the following exact contents:

/home/user/artifact_repo/project_alpha/core.bin
/home/user/artifact_repo/project_alpha/runner.exe

No artifacts found.
